description: Dismiss a proactive post suggestion so it stops appearing, or pass save_as_draft true to turn it into an unpublished draft instead. A draft is not scheduled and nothing is published. WRITE: confirm the exact suggestion with the user first. Never dismisses, and does not overwrite, a suggestion that was already turned into a post.

save_as_draft.description: True saves the suggestion as an unpublished draft and does not dismiss it. Omit to dismiss.

name: dismiss_suggestion
